title: Solitaire Suite
tagline: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell on crisp, readable cards — every FreeCell deal guaranteed winnable.
description: Three classic patience games in one polished suite. Large-index cards designed for phones, drag or tap-to-move, unlimited undo, hints, one-tap auto-finish and the bouncing win cascade. Klondike (Draw 1, Draw 3, limited passes), Spider (1, 2 or 4 suits) and FreeCell (4 or 3 cells) — every FreeCell deal is checked by a built-in solver before you see it. Deals are numbered: replay one, type in a friend's number, or race the same cards. Statistics track win rates, best times and fewest moves per variant, and an unfinished game is saved automatically.
controls: Drag cards, or tap a card to send it to its best spot · tap the stock to draw/deal · U/Ctrl+Z undo · H hint · Space draw · Esc pause
modes: Deal Lab: play any numbered deal
fablePass: Card pickup tilt + physically lit 3D flip
Win cascade: optional confetti + table glow
Court cards: illustrated portraits replacing the geometric busts
